explanation: On redhat-3.16 the org page mounts the Logs tab eagerly, so the hidden usage-logs table also renders the 'org/repo' text and the getByText locator resolves to three elements. Master gates the Logs fetch on the active tab, so the problem is latent there.
fix: Use getByRole('link', { name, exact: true }) for the three repository locators and the created repo's name for the 'nowrite-repo' substring match.
